reviews.text:
I had an operation and didn't know where to take my dogs. A friend told me about Rafa, and he was a lifesaver. My dogs have been wonderful and received excellent care.
Thank you so much, Rafa!
I feel so relieved knowing my dog ​​is in Rafa's hands. He's professional and provides excellent service; we'll definitely be back.

We've left our dog with Rafa several times and the experience is always super positive. You can tell Rafa knows a lot, he gets along very well with dogs and he enjoys it; it gives you a lot of peace of mind to leave your pet with him.
Always great. I've left my dog ​​there many times and she always comes back happy. Plus, it gives me great peace of mind that she sends me videos and photos every day of her stay.

My dog ​​is very attached to us and has trouble socializing with other dogs; he's very timid. With Rafa, we had absolutely no problems. You can tell he understands dogs and knows how to handle them. He sent us a video, and Osiris was near other dogs much bigger than him—I couldn't believe it when I saw it! The dog lives in a home environment, without cages, with space to run freely, daily walks, his usual food, his bed… our dog was perfectly cared for, and we were completely at ease because Rafa looks after them as if they were his own.

I left my two dogs there a few weeks ago and I was so happy. Rafa is very professional and it showed in how the dogs were when I picked them up: calm and stress-free. It's definitely become my go-to kennel. Thank you so much!

This is the first time we've left our dog with Rafa, and the experience has been incredibly positive.
Rafa is so affectionate and takes excellent care of the dogs. He even sends you daily videos of them. He's highly recommended, and we'll definitely leave our dog with him again whenever we need to. Thank you, Rafa! We'll trust you again to take care of Nilo. 🐶
Well, it's perfect as always, my dog ​​being with Rafa is like being at home.
